note: Nordea's basic credit card, Nordea Credit: 2.99 euros a month (none inside some of its service packages, which the game doesn't hold), and interest at the 3-month Euribor plus 14.90%, written as their sum on the Euribor Nordea's own example gives, 2.08% in April 2026: 16.98% a year.

sources.title: Nordea, Nordea Credit
sources.said: Nordea Credit maksaa 2,99 euroa kuukaudessa. ... Luoton korko on 3 kk euribor + 14,90 %. ... kun viitekorko 3 kk euribor on 2,08 % (04/2026).
